  • Ester Vonplon，生于瑞士施利伦/Schlieren，工作生活在瑞士卡斯特里施/Castrisch
  • “In my earlier work, you could see what it was all about and it was very much about photography, I think. Now it has gone…not beyond photography—but more about the picture itself, more abstract. For example, I recently made a project about the concept of white. In it, I was photographing only snow and salt, and how salt is affecting snow. When you look at them under a microscope, their shapes are like opposites…”
  • “I am very interested in holding onto the disappearing. It’s probably the core of everything that interests me. Everything is always about disappearing. Life, memories, in the end it’s what it’s all about.”
  • “I showed everything to Walter Keller, my mentor at that time, he told me to start working with large format to reduce the amount of images and to slow down in my working process.”
  • “I am not much interested in photography particularly. For my own work I use photography as a tool to create my images but photography itself interests me not too much. I am much more inspired by other art forms or literature, film, music.”
